recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13146 unless PA opens a new decision to revisit the later FHIR-15841 personal-vs-functional relationship model.
issue_request: FHIR-13146 was Published/Persuasive with Modification. It asked to separate RelatedPerson relationship and role/function concepts because the then-bound relationship value set mixed family relationships and roles. The approved modified resolution narrowed the change to opening RelatedPerson.relationship cardinality from 0..1 to 0..* and not adding roles to RelatedPerson under that issue.
initial_application: No standalone source commit was found for only FHIR-13146. Commit 2e012e76a18a08930e5396bbee8addc60c952edb (Tracker #14225) applied the substantive cardinality change by updating RelatedPerson.relationship from 0..1 to 0..*. The explicit FHIR-13146-tagged commit, 987c2abb05d766abc9b78c0d02cea42fe3e9a468, changed adjacent RelatedPerson typo/period wording and did not add a RelatedPerson.role element.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes relatedperson=RelatedPerson. Later PA decisions changed the model: FHIR-15841 added Patient.contact.role and RelatedPerson.role for functional roles while keeping relationship for personal relationships, and FHIR-29929 explicitly says FHIR-15841 addressed the RelatedPerson role/relationship request. Related issues FHIR-14225, FHIR-15841, and FHIR-29929 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the seed's approved cardinality is present, and changing or removing RelatedPerson.role would incorrectly reverse later applied/published PA decisions.
